versions.changelog:
omnifun 1.3.0

- Added a new "Security Model" section in the documentation, describing non-custodial API usage, unsigned calldata, and new agent spending controls (per-trade/daily limits, chain/action whitelist, emergency trading pause).
- Documented new endpoints for configuring agent security and spending controls.
- Added homepage metadata.
- All public endpoints are now documented as requiring no API key ("read-only usage").
- No code changes detected; documentation and metadata updates only.

omni.fun skill v1.2.0

- Simplified setup: The agent wallet private key is no longer required or referenced inside the skill—now users provide only an API key obtained by signing a message offline.
- Updated documentation to reflect the streamlined registration and environment variables.
- Removed mention of internal auto-registration and private key handling.
- All usage and reward instructions remain unchanged.

omni.fun v1.1.0 — Major Environment & Registration Improvements

- Added explicit environment variable `OMNIFUN_API_KEY` for authenticated actions; previous `OMNIFUN_AGENT_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY` now optional and only needed for auto-registration.
- New "First-Time Setup" section guides users on producing and storing API keys securely, including both manual and automated registration flows.
- Environment variable usage standardized throughout all code samples and documentation for clarity.
- No breaking changes to APIs or user flows; update focuses on developer experience and onboarding clarity.

omni.fun skill v1.0.0 — Initial Launch

- Launchpad for memecoins tradeable across 8 chains, with fast settlement (5–25s) via LayerZero.
- Graduation system: tokens auto-migrate to Uniswap V3 at $69K cap, with $69 USDC bounty per trigger and 50% LP fees to creator.
- Built-in agent fee incentives: first 100 agents trade free for 60 days, referral rebates, and weekly USDC rewards.
- Supports token launches, AI trading strategies (Venice-powered), cross-chain buy/sell, trading, portfolio, and webhook integrations for real-time alerts.
- REST API offers public and authenticated endpoints for trading, rewards, portfolio tracking, and more.
- Key features: bonding curve pricing, 0.5% creator fee on trades, oScore trust ratings, fast cross-chain trades, and detailed docs for rapid agent integration.
